title: Study of Zola-cel (BMS-986353), CD19 NEX-T CAR T Cells in Autoimmune Cytopenia (Breakfree-AiCE)
official: A Phase 2, Multicenter, Open-Label Study of Zolacabtagene Autoleucel (BMS-986353), CD19-Targeted NEX-T CAR T Cells, in Participants with Chronic Immune Thrombocytopenia (cITP) and Autoimmune Hemolytic Anemia (AIHA) (Breakfree-AiCE)
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the safety and tolerability of zola-cel in participants with ITP and participants with AIHA (Cohort 1 Part A). To evaluate the efficacy of zola-cel in participants with ITP and participants with AIHA (Cohort 1 Part B).
conditions: Chronic Immune Thrombocytopenia (cITP) and Autoimmune Hemolytic Anemia (AIHA)
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participants with cITP or AIHA.
2. At least 18 years of age.
3. Participants who have received at least 2 previous therapies which either did not work for the person or the person could not continue taking them due to side effects.
4. For cITP, the platelet counts need to be < 30 × 109/L or < 50 × 109/L if on certain medications called TPO-RA.
5. For AIHA, hemolysis needs to be documented by participant's doctor and the hemoglobin needs to be <10 g/dL without red blood cell transfusion, or transfusion dependent
Exclusion criteria:
1. ITP or AIHA associated with Evans syndrome, other autoimmune disease affecting whole body or a single organ requiring specific medications called immunosuppressants, certain viral-induced conditions including hepatitis C virus and HIV, certain drug and vaccine induced conditions, surgical procedures, hematologic malignancies (blood cancer), or nonblood cancer within 2 years.

sites.f: Otto Von Guericke Universitaet Magdeburg – Universitätsklinik für Hämatologie, Onkologie und Zelltherapie
